clue.text: Left in museum's keeping, they cause destruction

indicators.note: a thing kept is held within, so the museum's letters hold the other piece

parts.note: the V and A, London's Victoria and Albert Museum, written with its possessive S

explanation.surface: Something left in a museum's care turns out to be the culprits behind the damage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in ... keeping' means L sits inside V AND A'S. The V and A is the Victoria and Albert Museum in London.
explanation.definitionFit: Vandals are people who wilfully damage property, so they are agents of destruction.

clue.text: Ornament virtually any singer executes from the start

indicators.note: points to the opening letter of each of the words before it

explanation.surface: Practically every vocalist performs an ornament from the outset.
explanation.definitionFit: A vase is a decorative vessel, often kept as an ornament.

clue.text: Money that cannot be disposed of?

definitions.meaning: essential, not to be done without

explanation.definitionFit: The needful is slang for ready money, and needful also means necessary, indispensable.

clue.text: Commercial in the last month is not for children

parts.note: an ad is a commercial
ult., ultimo, means of last month in old business letters

explanation.surface: An advert that ran last month was unsuitable for youngsters.
explanation.definitionFit: Adult material is restricted to grown-ups, not meant for children.

clue.text: Artificial gem in emblem

parts.note: sham means fake, artificial
a rock is slang for a gemstone, especially a diamond

explanation.surface: A fake jewel set in a badge.
explanation.definitionFit: The shamrock is the national emblem of Ireland.

clue.text: Deputy endlessly on his feet?

indicators.note: without its end, so the final letter of the word is dropped

parts.note: someone on his feet is upright, standing

explanation.surface: A substitute who is kept standing all the time.
explanation.definitionFit: A stand-in is a substitute who takes another's place, just as a deputy does.

clue.text: Badly set university course, that's plain

indicators.note: a thing done badly is botched, so these letters are jumbled

parts.note: PPE, Philosophy, Politics and Economics, is a well-known Oxford degree course

explanation.surface: A poorly arranged degree course is called plain dull.
explanation.definitionFit: A steppe is a vast treeless grassy plain, as in Russia and Central Asia.

clue.text: Attack on reputation when one is actually present?

parts.note: as means when: 'as I arrived'
one is I, and actually present is in person, so I goes in PERSON

explanation.surface: A slur on someone's good name made while they stand there.
explanation.walkthrough: Read 'one is actually present' as 'I in person': I sits inside PERSON, after AS.
explanation.definitionFit: An aspersion is a damaging remark that casts a slur on someone's character.

clue.text: Study to break complete impasse

indicators.note: one piece breaks into the other, sitting inside it

parts.note: dead means complete, as in a dead loss
a den is a private study

explanation.surface: A study that breaks a total deadlock.
explanation.definitionFit: A dead end is a situation with no way forward, a stalemate or impasse.

clue.text: Withdrawn type is unlikely to be successful

definitions.meaning: a horse withdrawn before a race, one that never runs
an idea with no chance; the definition is adjectival where the answer is a noun

explanation.definitionFit: A non-starter is a horse withdrawn from its race, and also a plan with no prospect of success.

clue.text: Consider putting second coin in the collection

indicators.note: the coin goes inside the collection plate

parts.note: the church collection is taken in a plate passed round
the ecu was a European coin

explanation.surface: Someone puts a second coin into the church collection.
explanation.walkthrough: 'collection' is not a group of coins but the church collection plate; 'putting' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: To speculate is to ponder or theorise about something, a synonym of consider.

clue.text: Simply ugly

explanation.definitionFit: Plain is both an adverb meaning simply and an adjective meaning unattractive.

clue.text: Optimistic prediction will have been used as an example

definitions.meaning: a forecast that the time ahead will be flawless

definitions.text: will have been used as an example
definitions.meaning: the grammatical tense shown by 'will have been', a verb form

explanation.surface: A rosy forecast is cited as a model case.
explanation.definitionFit: A tense name in grammar, read literally as an ideal time to come, giving a forecast of bliss.

clue.text: A myth about car being within one's means

indicators.note: the myth word goes round the car word

parts.note: a fable is a myth or legend
a Ford is a make of car

explanation.surface: A legend surrounding a motor that people can afford.
explanation.definitionFit: Affordable means cheap enough to be bought, within one's financial means.

clue.text: Complete support for footballer

parts.note: complete means full
to back is to support

explanation.surface: Total backing offered to a football player.
explanation.definitionFit: A full-back is a defensive player position in football.

clue.text: In Botswana I relaxed — I'm chaired to work

indicators.note: loosened and arranged afresh, so these letters are reordered

explanation.surface: Someone resting in southern Africa says they are carried in a seat to their job.
explanation.walkthrough: A bosun is hoisted aloft in a boatswain's chair, a plank seat on ropes, to work on the rigging.
explanation.definitionFit: A boatswain is a ship's officer who works aloft seated in a boatswain's chair.

clue.text: One that secures worker in Morocco

definitions.meaning: something that ties or fastens things together
a bookbinder, who works in morocco, a fine goatskin leather used for book covers

explanation.surface: A man who fastens things has a job in North Africa.
explanation.walkthrough: Morocco is not the country but the leather used in bookbinding; the capital letter misleads.
explanation.definitionFit: A binder fastens things, and a bookbinder works with morocco leather.

clue.text: Hangings mean the end

definitions.meaning: drapes hung at windows or a stage
slang for death or finish: 'it's all over for you'

explanation.definitionFit: Curtains are drapes and, in slang, the end or death.

clue.text: Form of treatment given to soldiers is a trying experience

parts.note: OR, other ranks, means soldiers who are not officers
a deal is how one is treated: a raw deal

explanation.surface: Soldiers get a particular kind of handling that tests them hard.
explanation.definitionFit: An ordeal is a painful or harrowing experience, one that tries a person.

clue.text: Duke with Dickensian manservant is resident

parts.note: Sam Weller is Mr Pickwick's servant in Dickens's Pickwick Papers

explanation.surface: A duke and his Dickens-style valet live there.
explanation.definitionFit: A dweller is someone who lives in a place, a resident or inhabitant.

clue.text: A paying way to convert fish

parts.note: to turn something is to change or convert it
the pike is a freshwater fish

explanation.surface: A profitable method of transforming fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A turnpike is a toll road, a way one has to pay to use.

clue.text: A bike with an ordered flower arrangement

indicators.note: put in order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone with a bicycle orders a floral display.
explanation.walkthrough: 'with' is a link joining the two parts of the fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: Ikebana is the Japanese art of arranging flowers.

clue.text: Proverbial coming disaster

indicators.note: a disaster wrecks things, so these letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A catastrophe is on the way, as the saying goes.
explanation.definitionFit: Gnomic means expressed in short maxims or aphorisms, like proverbs.

clue.text: Preparing household food, one'll usually have a large glass on top

definitions.text: one'll usually have a large glass on top

parts.note: dressing food or a wound is preparing it
the table is the food served in a household: 'keep a good table'

explanation.surface: Someone preparing the family meal has a big glass of drink set out.
explanation.definitionFit: A dressing table is bedroom furniture usually topped with a large mirror.

clue.text: Bachelor victim of fratricide in tower

parts.note: in Genesis Abel is killed by his brother Cain

explanation.surface: An unmarried man is murdered by his brother up a tower.
explanation.definitionFit: The Tower of Babel is the Genesis tower whose builders' language was confused.

clue.text: Old character used to raise pheasants, some say

indicators.note: flags that the word is spoken, a sound-alike

parts.note: a beater flushes game birds out of cover for the guns

explanation.surface: An antique figure was employed to flush game birds, people claim.
explanation.walkthrough: In non-rhotic British speech BEATER and the Greek letter sound alike.
explanation.definitionFit: Beta is the second letter of the ancient Greek alphabet, an old written character.

clue.text: Wood, a thick piece brought back

indicators.note: these words turn the whole run backwards

parts.note: a slab is a thick flat piece

explanation.surface: A chunk of timber carried back home.
explanation.definitionFit: Balsa is a very light wood from a tropical American tree.

clue.text: Right ambiance, perhaps, for one that may get spliced

indicators.note: signals that the letters are only one possible arrangement, to be reshuffled

explanation.surface: A suitable atmosphere might suit something due for joining.
explanation.walkthrough: 'perhaps' rearranges R plus AMBIANCE; 'for' is a link. 'Splice the mainbrace' is the naval order for an extra rum ration.
explanation.definitionFit: The main brace is a ship's rope; to splice it is the naval idiom for an issue of grog.

clue.text: Republic, mainly pleasant and aiming at peace

parts.note: Eire is the Irish name of the Republic of Ireland

indicators.note: taking most but not all, so the last letter goes

parts.note: nice means pleasant

explanation.surface: A republic described as largely agreeable and peace-seeking.
explanation.definitionFit: Eirenic (irenic) describes something conciliatory, intended to promote peace.

clue.text: Sovereign's mistress, a fruity little thing

definitions.meaning: a wife or concubine of an Ottoman ruler

explanation.surface: A ruler's lover is a racy little number.
explanation.definitionFit: A sultana is both a sultan's consort and a small dried grape.
